2609.29963.title: ADATEX4D: adaptive texture capacity allocation for 4D gaussian splatting
2609.29963.paper_summary: Textured Gaussians improve local appearance capacity, but assigning the same texture resolution to every primitive wastes storage on low-detail or weakly visible regions. We introduce AdaTex4D, an adaptive texture-capacity module for deformation-based 4D Gaussian Splatting. Each Gaussian carries packed RGBA triplanes whose two axes grow independently according to visibility normalized screen-space gradients and deformed local scales. Experiments on N3DV and PanopticSports show that AdaTex4D reduces texture storage by more than half while preserving reconstruction quality. Under fixed memory budgets, adaptive allocation also improves quality over uniform texture assignment and reduces overall model and peak memory. These results show that dynamic, anisotropic texture allocation provides a more efficient way to distribute local appearance capacity in 4D Gaussian representations.
2609.29963.paper_summary_zh: 紋理高斯改善了局部外觀能力，但將相同的紋理解析度分配給每個原始體會在低細節或弱可見區域浪費儲存空間。我們介紹了 AdaTex4D，一個用於基於變形的 4D 高斯噴濺的自適應紋理容量模塊。每個高斯攜帶打包的 RGBA 三平面，其兩個軸根據可見性標準化的螢幕空間梯度和變形的局部比例獨立增長。在 N3DV 和 PanopticSports 的實驗顯示，AdaTex4D 將紋理儲存減少了一半以上，同時保持重建質量。在固定的記憶體預算下，自適應分配也改善了質量，相較於均勻的紋理分配，並減少了整體模型和峰值記憶體。這些結果顯示，動態的各向異性紋理分配提供了一種更有效的方式來分配 4D 高斯表示中的局部外觀容量。
